oneLine: Snapdeal shifts focus to value fashion ahead of its planned IPO.

sources.title: Snapdeal Shifts Focus To Value Fashion Ahead Of IPO

synopsis: Snapdeal parent company AceVector is launching an initial public offering to raise ₹420 crore through a combination of a fresh issue of ₹287 crore and an offer for sale of up to 4.16 crore shares valued at approximately ₹133 crore. The IPO price band is set at ₹30 to ₹32 per share, with the post-issue valuation expected to reach ₹1,741 crore. The subscription period opens on September 25 and closes on September 29, 2026. The company is shifting its business strategy to focus on a value fashion and lifestyle marketplace rather than a broad horizontal e-commerce platform.
